1/4 in cotton drawstring through two antique silver eyelets
Faux fly (J-stitch), no zip: a true pull-on
Slant front pockets; pointed patch back pockets with hidden darts
Permanent 1 1/2 in turn-up cuff, tacked at the inseam and outseam
Woven digs patches on the right back pocket and the left cuff
